summary: Backend and mobile-first frontend regression completed on preview URL. Core hero/globe/waitlist/navigation flows passed at 390x844 and fresh 320x740. One backend regression found: brand asset cache policy is returned as no-store on public endpoint.

critical.issue: Public response returns Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate instead of expected cacheable policy (e.g., public, max-age=86400).

action_items: Fix cache header behavior for /api/brand/logo and /api/brand/earth on public preview route; verify edge/ingress is not overriding backend Cache-Control.
Re-run backend brand asset pytest after cache header fix.
critical_code_review_comments: brand_assets.py sets cacheable headers in FastAPI response, but public endpoint currently serves no-store; likely rewritten upstream (proxy/CDN).
Frontend correctly requests brand assets only through /api/brand/* (storage credentials/paths are not exposed in frontend API layer).
All tested interactive elements include stable testID selectors and were tappable in mobile viewport testing.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_/test_ui_* waitlist entries via pytest and UI runs, including one duplicate-email verification entry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested UI flows passed on preview URL at both target mobile sizes; only outstanding regression is cache-control policy returned by public brand asset endpoints.
rca_of_issue: Repro: GET https://contech-os-app.preview.emergentagent.com/api/brand/logo returns 200 image/png but Cache-Control=no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate. Backend code intends public cache header, so root cause is likely header override at ingress/CDN layer rather than API handler logic.
